verdict.rationale: My DOR is an online filing and payment portal, so user-configured background automation (such as scheduled payments or recurring filings) is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows none. The ACH debit is a one-off payment on a submitted return, not a recurring schedule. The Small Business Credit auto-calculation and the 24/7 automated phone line are adjacent features, not automations a user sets up. No API or agent-facing surface was found (llms.txt and OpenAPI paths return 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
